name: SDTM-MSG v2.0 study file
description: A test study file listed after the shared seed (data/methods/sdtm_methods.json). It adds the 13 SDTM-MSG v2.0 methods the seed does not ship and the assignments for the 14 items the seed alone gives another method or a placeholder, so the seed plus this file reproduces every method assignment in the MSG v2.0 define.xml.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive AEENTPT
methods.description: If AEENRTPT is populated, AEENTPT is DM.RFPENDTC for the subject.

parameters.name: AEENRTPT
parameters.description: End relative to reference time point

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.AEENTPT, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive CMENTPT
methods.description: If CMENRTPT is populated, CMENTPT is DM.RFPENDTC for the subject.

parameters.name: CMENRTPT
parameters.description: End relative to reference time point

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.CMENTPT, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive DISEQ
methods.description: Starts at "1" for first device identifier and increments by one for each DIPARM
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.DISEQ, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive EXDOSE
methods.description: EXDOSE = ECDOSE * ECPSTRG expressed in mg.

parameters.name: ECDOSE
parameters.description: Dose per administration, in the exposure-as-collected units

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.EXDOSE, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive FTSTRESN
methods.description: If FTSTRESC is numeric then FTSTRESN=FTSTRESC in numeric format, else null.
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.FTSTRESN, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive IEORRES
methods.description: If IECAT=INCLUSION then IEORRES=N, else if IECAT=EXCLUSION then IEORRES=Y
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.IEORRES, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive LBSTRESC
methods.description: LBSTRESC is equal to LBORRES or the value in standard units if a conversion is necessary.
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.LBSTRESC, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive QSSTRESC_PH
methods.description:
If QSORRES="Not at all" then 0
If QSORRES="Several days" then 1
If QSORRES="More than half the days" then 2
If QSORRES="Nearly every day" then 3
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.QSSTRESC_PH, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive QSSTRESC_PH_10_11
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.QSSTRESC_PH_10_11, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive QSSTRESC_SL
methods.description:
If QSORRES="Strongly disagree" then 1
If QSORRES="Disagree" then 2
If QSORRES="Slightly disagree" then 3
If QSORRES="Neither agree nor disagree" then 4
If QSORRES="Slightly agree" then 5
If QSORRES="Agree" then 6
If QSORRES="Strongly agree" then 7
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.QSSTRESC_SL, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive QSSTRESN
methods.description: If QSSTRESC is numeric then QSSTRESN=QSSTRESC in numeric format, else null.
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.QSSTRESN, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RSSTRESC
methods.description: RSSTRESC is the corresponding numeric value of RSORRES according the values shown on the HAMD-17 CRF page.
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.RSSTRESC, verbatim; draft signature.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive VSSTRESC
methods.description: Data collected in conventional units (i.e. F, lbs, inches) is converted using standard conversion factors to standard units (C, kg, cm).
methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.VSSTRESC, verbatim; draft signature.

assignments.name: DISEQ
assignments.description: Outranks the seed's --SEQ: an exact name beats a suffix.

assignments.name: QSSTRESC
assignments.description: QSPH value level: the where clause QSTESTCD IN (PHQ0101, ..., PHQ0109) admits PHQ0101.

assignments.name: QSSTRESC
assignments.description: QSSL. QSPH and QSSL are both domain QS, so a where entry above outranks this one for the QSPH value-level items.
